intended_object: The ring of integers ℤ viewed as a module over itself (the free ℤ-module of rank one), used as the coefficient group for (affine) simplicial chains. Inferred from the docstring and from its use as the coefficient module in `(affineSSet m).chainComplex affineIntegerCoefficients`.
explanation: The body is `ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ`, which is exactly ℤ with its regular module structure over itself, as an object of the category of ℤ-modules. This matches the docstring. It is a particular object: the usual integer coefficients for chains with ℤ coefficients. Being specific is not a sign that it is too narrow. The library uses it only as the coefficient module when building the simplicial chain complex of the affine simplex. It is just a name for Mathlib's `ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ`, and Mathlib has no separate named declaration for ℤ as an object of `ModuleCat ℤ`.
